data.one_liner: Animated radial and pie charts for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets to display animated circular charts, including pie and radial types. Users supply data entries and can update them to animate transitions.
use_when: Need animated circular charts without heavy dependencies
Want quick integration of pie or radial charts in a Flutter app
Prefer a simple API for chart data updates
avoid_when: Require advanced chart features like tooltips, legends, or custom animations beyond the provided options
Need cross-platform charting with extensive customization like other chart libraries
strengths: Easy to use API with GlobalKey for updates
Supports both pie and radial charts with animation
weaknesses: Limited customization compared to larger chart libraries
No built-in support for legends, tooltips, or complex interactions
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: More features, larger community, supports more chart types and customization

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Rich feature set, enterprise support, extensive chart types
